terminology_decisions.basa / tembung / tetembungan: Actual full C48 basa and C49 tembung read during drafting and review. Tembung first sense and tetembungan support word/words; unrelated stick/ball/barrage homonyms excluded. Basa Aljabar is source-defined language framing, not a claim that the draft is krama or that the entry standardizes algebra terminology.
terminology_decisions.wilangan / cacah: Actual full C01 wilangan and C02 cacah read; relevant count/number senses selected. Wilangan cacah and wilangan bulat remain source-defined compounds with the latter a declared bulat loan, not confused with a physical round object.
terminology_decisions.pangkat: Actual full C34 rambang directly attests mathematical power. Retain provisional school loan pangkat in the future collage to match already drafted A10 nomenclature; record rambang as attested alternative, not force a silent cross-unit change.
terminology_decisions.collage technical loans: Aljabar, desimal, riil, model, persamaan, geometri, polinomial, ekspresi, matematika, pecahan, linear, persen and grafik are declared technical loans. Conversational ekspresi uses wujud aljabar consistently with the existing A10 draft. Geometry/font fit of this longer vertical phrase awaits asset review.
terminology_decisions.everyday examples: Tip/pelayan/restoran/bisbol and rata-rata pukulan are provisional everyday/technical loans in the source context. Preserve tip, change and baseball batting-average examples; no tip amount, financial advice, sports statistics or unit conversion added. Susuk is ordinary change, not algebraic substitution.
terminology_decisions.registers: Separate ngoko-derived provisional academic and conversational framing; sampeyan vs kowe, nyinaoni vs sinau. Not certified standardized Javanese, krama or approved spoken pronunciation.
terminology_decisions.source-image distinction: Effective ID source references an Indonesian SVG redraw975×450; EN references its canonical JPEG. Geometry preservation must be checked against the inherited ID SVG, not claim byte identity with JPEG. English equation/equations become repeated persamaan in ID; preserve both occurrences.
terminology_decisions.source-description limitation: IDSVGdesc lists16distinct terms; the18visible text elements contain17distinct terms including riil. Record omission without changing the pivot or inventing an exhaustive-description correction. CNXMLalt is explicitly examples, not a complete lexicon.

phrases: Kolase istilah matematika seperti aljabar, desimal, persamaan, bilangan, geometri, polinomial, dan pecahan. Kata-katanya ditulis mendatar maupun tegak dengan berbagai warna.
Kolase istilah matematika kayata aljabar, desimal, persamaan, wilangan, geometri, polinomial, lan pecahan. Tetembungane ditulis mendatar lan jejeg kanthi manéka warna.
Kolase istilah matematika kayata aljabar, desimal, persamaan, wilangan, geometri, polinomial, lan pecahan. Tembung-tembunge ditulis mendatar lan jejeg nganggo werna-werna.
Aljabar memiliki bahasanya sendiri. Gambar ini menunjukkan beberapa kata yang mungkin Anda jumpai dan gunakan ketika mempelajari Praaljabar.
Aljabar nduweni basane dhewe. Gambar iki nuduhake sawetara tembung sing bisa ditemoni lan digunakake nalika nyinaoni Praaljabar.
Aljabar duwe basane dhewe. Ing gambar iki ana sawetara tembung sing bisa koktemoni lan kokanggo nalika sinau Praaljabar.

Mungkin Anda tidak menyadarinya, tetapi Anda telah menggunakan aljabar setiap hari. Barangkali Anda menghitung besarnya tip untuk pramusaji di restoran. Mungkin Anda menghitung uang kembalian yang seharusnya diterima ketika membayar sesuatu. Bisa juga ketika Anda membandingkan rata-rata pukulan pemain bisbol favorit Anda. Anda dapat menjelaskan aljabar yang Anda gunakan dengan istilah tertentu dan mengikuti proses yang teratur. Dalam bab ini, Anda akan mempelajari kata-kata yang digunakan untuk menjelaskan aljabar dan mulai menempuh jalan untuk menyelesaikan soal-soal aljabar dengan mudah, baik di kelas maupun dalam kehidupan sehari-hari.

Mbokmenawa sampeyan ora ngrumangsani, nanging sampeyan wis nggunakake aljabar saben dina. Bisa uga sampeyan ngetung akehe dhuwit tip kanggo pelayan ing restoran. Mbokmenawa sampeyan ngetung dhuwit susuk sing kudune ditampa nalika mbayar barang. Bisa uga nalika sampeyan mbandhingake rata-rata pukulan pemain bisbol sing paling disenengi. Aljabar sing sampeyan gunakake bisa diandharake nganggo istilah tartamtu lan kanthi ngetutake proses sing tumata. Ing bab iki, sampeyan bakal nyinaoni tetembungan sing digunakake kanggo ngandharake aljabar lan miwiti sinau ngrampungake soal-soal aljabar kanthi gampang, ing kelas uga ing urip saben dina.

Kowe mbokmenawa ora sadhar, nanging saben dina kowe wis nganggo aljabar. Contone, nalika ngetung akehe dhuwit tip kanggo pelayan ing restoran. Utawa ngetung dhuwit susuk sing kudune koktampa nalika mbayar barang. Bisa uga nalika mbandhingake rata-rata pukulan pemain bisbol sing paling koksenengi. Aljabar sing kokanggo kuwi bisa kokterangake nganggo istilah tartamtu lan proses sing runtut. Ing bab iki, kowe bakal sinau tembung-tembung kanggo nerangake aljabar lan miwiti sinau ngrampungake soal-soal aljabar kanthi gampang, ing kelas lan ing urip saben dina.
